koi_sma.description: Orbital distance of the planet around its star.

flare_rate_month.description: Number of big flares (1e34 erg or more) per month.

flare_rate_all.description: Number of all flares per month.

max_logE.description: log10 of the energy of the strongest flare in erg.

cme_prob.description: Probability that a flare is followed by a coronal mass ejection. Used in the formula label only. When left empty the default is used.

ok.description: True when the inputs passed validation and the model ran.

errors.description: Plain-English messages about inputs that are missing or not usable. Empty when ok is true.

flags.description: Non-blocking notes, such as values outside the training range.

ml_class.description: Risk class from the dose-label model.

probabilities.description: Class probability for each of Low, Medium and High, adding up to 1.

formula_label.description: Risk class from the R_eff formula.

r_eff.description: Relative atmospheric escape at the planet from the formula.

star_type.description: Star type code from the star temperature: 0 F, 1 G, 2 K, 3 M.

star_type_letter.description: Spectral letter of the star type.

drivers.description: Top drivers for the ml_class, largest absolute contribution first. Each item has feature, name, value, contribution and direction (toward, away or neutral).

notes: This is a physics-based risk score, not measured ozone loss.
Planned: inputs from Sub-topics 1, 2 and 3. Column names and units are not confirmed with those sub-topics.
